symptom: A brain could be started before its project only by accident: store commands took -p and used filepath.Dir of a path nothing opened; `brain init <dir>` accepted the directory and silently ignored it; and `mxcli new` refused any directory that already held the brain
cause: No way to name a brain's directory (`brainProjectPath` required -p, and `init` declared no Args), and `cmd_new.go`'s non-empty check plus `moveProject`'s rename-then-os.CopyFS fallback assumed an empty destination
insight: **A feature that works only because nothing opens a path is one Stat away from gone — and the fallback that seems to support it is unsafe.** os.CopyFS merges into an existing directory (MkdirAll on dirs, O_EXCL on files), so moving a project onto a brain appeared to work; the first shared file stopped it half way, leaving App.mpr moved and the stage gutted. The merge test passes against that accident; only the conflict test (6 files where there were 4) proves the pre-check. Adoption is kept to exactly docs/brain (with mxcli's marker) and .mxcli/brain, so `new` never merges into someone's files. Test helpers that drive the shared rootCmd must reset -p/-C, or a -C from one run turns the next run's -p into 'both passed'
